name: inhibitor of DNA binding 3
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ID3 encodes DNA-binding protein inhibitor ID-3. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and transcription regulator inhibitor activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Burkitt lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
